assumptions: Parameters reconstructed from saved profile and verified against cache shape; no C++ runtime initialized.
Fractions represent actual binary64 parameter values; final C++ long-double arithmetic/rounding is not modelled.

exact_legacy_rotation_contract.arithmetic: Exact rational predicates on serialized binary64 positions; no epsilon.
exact_legacy_rotation_contract.scope: Boundary of the legacy two-triangle-per-edge linear 4D wall only; not whole-window admission.

source_interval_audit.reason: Candidate branch boundaries are extracted analytically for registry-linked records and observed boundary VIDs. Full exterior incidence, selected-owner equivalence, and all-source ownership over the interval remain uncertified.

legacy_sidewall_samples.sampling: Fixed alpha=1/4,1/2,3/4 in each slab; duplicate shared wall-vertices remain in RMS.
legacy_sidewall_samples.distance: One-way sliced old-wall vertices to corresponding ordinary boundary edge; not Hausdorff and not the continuous-time maximum.
